title: Positive or not
prompt: Return the text "positive" if n is greater than zero, otherwise "not positive". solve(5) is "positive".
hints: if with a comparison, an indented return, then else with its own return.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
